I can’t refund twice the amount you paid. The policy allows only the amount paid for the item, and the amount can’t be increased (refund-policy/v2/amount).

The shop’s records show your egg cooker was received back and hasn’t been refunded yet (refund-policy/v2/return) (refund-policy/v2/remaining). If you’d like, I can request a refund for the amount you actually paid.
